items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: we'd all meet there and play poker... or De Lille, his right name, but we always said big ol' Louis.

ctx.x: Well we'd all meet there and play poker, play piano, and sometimes bring up a drum. It was very nice. And all the, all the do, and they're drinking, they're drinking, who's bold, and they're behind the bars, they had crick, and they had the money to go on you, this and on you, and that's the zone too. They'd be there till sunrise. Yeah, now you take like Louis, and we take big ol' Louis, see, but it's a little nothing, a little decou, you know, or De Lille, his right name, but we always said big ol' Louis. Now…
